description: Run the built-in analyzer for the target's format (ELF/PE/Mach-O, Go, .NET, WASM, EVM, SQLite, plist, APK, ZIP, Electron ASAR, JavaScript apps, source maps, HAR). Returns a summary, findings with confidence, limitations, a compact overview and the collections available for paging. Large JavaScript apps are read in batches: when `complete` is false, `coverage` says how many files are unread and every list covers the scanned part only; call again with scan to read more.

batch.description: JavaScript apps only: files per batch (default 5000)

detail.description: overview size: brief (default) lists only counts, full adds samples of every list

fresh.description: JavaScript apps only: discard the stored scan first; combines with scan

include.description: JavaScript apps only: read the unread files under these paths (prefix or * pattern)

scan.description: JavaScript apps only: continue = read the next batch of unread files, all = read every unread file, fresh = discard the stored scan and start again

name: hexvero_analyze
title: Analyze target
